rules_note: the policy rules a candidate's rule is read as: every rule a tool refuses with (CONTRACTS section 10), and no other. repo_code is not one: its decision is ask, never a refusal. A declined approval and a delegation outside task_allow name none and are not counted.
id_form: refusal-<rule>-<role>-<10 hex>, rule and role reduced to [a-z0-9_-]
